'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are a forageable item found in most outdoor areas. It does not require any technologies to collect. After unlocking the Insects technology of the [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|Farming and Nature tech tree]], collecting Yellow Flowers may also yield [[Butterfly|Butterflies]] during the day or [[Moth|Moths]] at night.

==Alchemy==
{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is decomposable into [[Life solution|solution]] and [[Life extract|extract]] with the [[hand mixer]] and any of the distillation cubes, respectively. Having unlocked the [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.
